_readme: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER DATA. Every posting below was written by hand for this repo. None of them is a real job advert, and none is evidence about any real company. They exist only so the website can be deployed and demonstrated before enough real postings have been labeled. A model trained on these learns the author's assumptions about ghost-job wording, NOT a real-world pattern, so any model built from this file is marked kind='demo' and the website says so prominently. Replace it by labeling real postings with the labeling tool and running train.py with no --demo flag.
